The ticket is #8841. I replied in your thread in #central-random.

That number comes from Tobias's message in that channel yesterday at 09:27. He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841.

He called it "Tobias's dealer account," though, not Marrow Fieldworks. The Central handoff digest says Marrow Fieldworks changed hands on 5 Jan, but it doesn't say who took it over. So the link to Marrow Fieldworks is my best guess, not something written down. I asked Tobias in the thread to confirm before your call.
